title: A subroutine that multiplies by four
task: Write a subroutine that multiplies A by 4 (modulo 256) and returns with RET. Load x, call it and show the result on port 3; call it again and show 16 times x; then stop. SAP-2 has no ADD A: copy A to another register first. Keep the label x and its DB line.
starter:
; times-four -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, SAP-2)
; Show 4 times x, then 16 times x, on port 3, with one subroutine called twice.
; Hint: A + A twice is 4 times A.
        HLT           ; replace with your code

        ORG 0800H     ; the data, in the RAM
x:      DB 0
